rendering.state: exact same saved qpos at each queried frame; no stepping

selection: Maximize pooled terminal development AUROC; ties prefer the temperature closest to 1. Select separately for rgb and rgb+rgblh. Freeze before reporting test AUROC.
metric: Pooled terminal success/incomplete AUROC on 72 test continuations from four source scenes. Positive score = negative expected DT bin; T0 uses negative argmax bin. No classification thresholds.
baseline: Reuse exact saved DINO goal cosine and Robometer native terminal success-head scores. Robometer progress head retained as an ablation. No visual goal supplied to Robometer.
goal: Same successful source top-camera endpoint shared across all branches, independent of their final outcome.
limitations: Four previously inspected test scenes; synthetic branches are correlated. Development selection is separated by source, but this is an exploratory reused-scene study.
